cases.name: aa_06utc_request_spike_investigation
cases.question: We are seeing a huge spike in the provider monitoring dashboard for Provider AA at the 06:00 UTC hour over at least the past 4 days. It is showing roughly 20,000 requests in a single minute for 1-3 minutes, which is way beyond our internal cap of 90 TPS (5,400 requests per minute). Please investigate using the underlying data: query prod.monitoring.provider_combined_audit and prod.monitoring.combined_audit, look at the request volume broken down by hour and minute for provider AA over the last 4 days, confirm whether this spike is real traffic or a data aggregation / display artifact, identify the root cause, and tell us what to do about it.

cases.name: smartest_customer_master_question
cases.question: use all of your knowledge of priceeye and search for all available prod tables, then query their data partitions for yesterday. Define your own criteria for what makes a customer smart (e.g. billing efficiency, collection health, anomaly program quality, competitive coverage), query as many prod tables as you can find for each customer, then rank all customers with supporting data and a clear justification. Do not ask for clarification — discover the tables yourself, pick your own criteria and run the queries.
